scheme_name: Subsidy Scheme On Establishment Of 40 R.I.R. Birds Unit For Divyang People
other_conditions: Beneficiary must be an adult belonging to the Divyang community in Gujarat
Income proof must be submitted with the application
Priority is given to female applicants and those below the poverty line
Applicant must have completed poultry‑keeping training
Beneficiary must ensure the birds are kept safe during night hours
The unit must be maintained for two years as per scheme conditions
benefits_summary: Provides a 40 R.I.R bird unit with poultry feed and a 90% subsidy (up to ₹7200), along with regular vaccination of the birds.
